_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-12 (V1.1 reconciliation: owner-controlled reschedule notification, replacing the V1.1-original automatic mismatch trigger). Live ID: WzWw9vCYOCS6dSSS. New design: the owner edits 'Appt Date'/'Appt Time' on the Appointments sheet as many times as needed, then checks 'Notify Customer' = TRUE when ready. Hourly, this workflow scans for Scheduled rows with Notify Customer = TRUE, sends the customer a YES/NO reschedule-confirmation SMS referencing the new date/time, sets 'Reschedule Status' = 'Pending Customer Confirmation', updates 'Notified Appt Date'/'Notified Appt Time' to the new values, resets Reminder 24h/2h (so WF09 sends fresh reminders for the new time), clears Notify Customer back to FALSE, logs the SMS to the Communication Log via the CRM Adapter, and alerts the owner (email by default, SMS optional via CONFIG.SMS_ALERTS_ENABLED). Customer YES/NO replies are handled by WF10 (Reschedule Cancel), which also tracks 'Reschedule Attempts' and escalates to 'Manual Follow-Up Required' after 2 declined offers. See CRM_SHEET_SCHEMA.md for the 'Notify Customer'/'Reschedule Status'/'Reschedule Attempts' columns.
name: Appointment Reschedule Notifier

parameters.content: Hourly: reads the Appointments sheet for Status = Scheduled rows where the owner has checked 'Notify Customer' = TRUE. For each, sends the customer a YES/NO reschedule-confirmation SMS referencing the current Appt Date/Time, sets 'Reschedule Status' = 'Pending Customer Confirmation', updates 'Notified Appt Date'/'Notified Appt Time' to match, clears Reminder 24h/2h so WF09 sends fresh reminders for the new time, and resets 'Notify Customer' back to FALSE. Logs the SMS to the Communication Log via the CRM Adapter and alerts the owner (email by default, SMS optional via CONFIG.SMS_ALERTS_ENABLED). The owner can edit Appt Date/Time as many times as needed before checking the box - only the final state triggers a notification. Customer YES/NO replies are handled by WF10 (Reschedule Cancel). CONFIG block lives at the top of 'Detect Appointment Changes'.
